title: Felt CLI: felt compile, felt check, felt run
description: Command-line tool using clap. Three subcommands: (1) felt compile foo.felt -o foo.wasm — full pipeline, produce WASM binary. (2) felt check foo.felt — type-check and termination-check only, report errors via ariadne. (3) felt run foo.felt --state game.json — interpret locally without WASM for debugging (tree-walking interpreter over the typed AST). Rust binary in felt/src/main.rs. Dependencies: clap, ariadne.
